notes: tal.net (Oleeo), no adapter. Linked from https://www.evercore.com/careers/professionals/ (Experienced Hires board). Verified = board confirmed, no matching title.

Sibling sites on the same tenant: 'Campus' (28 postings, students/interns; reachable, no matching title on first pages) and 'External' (1 posting).

Careers page (https://www.lincolninternational.com/careers-and-culture/careers/) injects a Greenhouse iframe at runtime; board token lincolninternational (41 postings, absolute_url on lincolninternational.com/greenhouse/?gh_jid=). verify_one ok n=16. Do not use board 'lincoln' (a different company).

IBM/Infinite BrassRing Talent Gateway (TGnewUI), no adapter. Search URL: https://jobs.ubs.com/TGnewUI/Search/Home/Home?partnerid=25008&siteid=5012 (returns 200 to curl; jobs.ubs.com/ root and ubs.com/global/en/careers/search-jobs.html return 403). Listings load via session-bound AJAX posts (TGnewUI/Search/Ajax/...) that need the page's anti-forgery token; no public JSON/RSS feed found.

sample_title: Private Bank - Client Service Executive - Associate/AVP
notes: Custom careers site (Workday behind it, R-numbers) with a public JSON API, no adapter but easy to add. Search: GET https://api-deutschebank.beesite.de/search/?data=<url-encoded JSON> with {"LanguageCode":"en","SearchParameters":{"FirstItem":1,"CountItem":N,"Keywords":[{"Value":"investment banking"}],"MatchedObjectDescriptor":["PositionID","PositionTitle","PositionURI","PositionLocation.CountryName","PositionLocation.CityName"]},"SearchCriteria":[]} -> SearchResult.SearchResultItems (about 1,900 postings overall; SearchCriteria can filter by PositionLocation.Country id). Detail with full description HTML: GET https://api-deutschebank.beesite.de/jobhtml/<PositionID>.json -> {"html": ...}. Both return 200 without cookies or a browser.

hsbc.com/careers/find-a-job leads to https://portal.careers.hsbc.com (Eightfold, alias hsbc.eightfold.ai). pcsx API is disabled ('PCSX is not enabled for this user'), so api must be the apply/v2 one (/api/apply/v2/jobs?domain=hsbc.com). verify_one ok n=3 on the default four queries. Board is global; US roles are a minority.

Custom group site, no adapter. US listing: https://group.bnpparibas/en/careers/all-job-offers/united-states (35 offers when checked in a normal browser, paginated with ?page=N; job pages at /en/careers/job-offer/<slug>). The site returns 403 to curl and to a plain fetch (bot protection, not bypassed), job pages carry no JSON-LD, and the only feed (https://group.bnpparibas/en/rss) is the news feed. No public JSON/RSS job endpoint found; would need a headless browser.

nomura.com/americas/careers links to https://careers.nomura.com/Nomura/go/Career-Opportunities-Americas/9050800/ (SuccessFactors career site; /search/?q= works at the host root, job links under /Nomura/job/...). verify_one ok n=18. Global experienced-hire board (Americas category id 9050800). Campus roles are separate on nomuracampus.tal.net (no adapter).

Avature, no adapter. Search: https://recruitment.macquarie.com/en_US/careers/SearchJobs/?jobRecordsPerPage=9 (server-rendered HTML, links to /en_US/careers/JobDetail?jobId=<id>; reachable with curl). Public RSS without a browser: https://recruitment.macquarie.com/en_US/careers/SearchJobs/feed/ (title, link, pubDate; description element is empty, so descriptions need the JobDetail HTML page). The US careers page uses a filtered SearchJobs URL (?7959=[421070,421069]&7959_format=14495) for its regional listing.

No own board any more. The guessed tenant comerica.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com does not exist (422). Openings for the former Comerica franchise are on Fifth Third's board (fifththird.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com, site 53careers, answers the Workday API), which is a different employer and is not recorded here as Comerica's. Suggest dropping Comerica from the list or replacing it with Fifth Third.

Oracle Taleo (zionsbancorp.taleo.net) fronted by Oracle SelectMinds / Taleo Social Sourcing at https://careers.zionsbancorp.com (also growwithzions.zionsbancorp.com), no adapter. zionsbancorporation.com/careers returns 403 to curl. The SelectMinds site is server-rendered and reachable with curl: listing at https://careers.zionsbancorp.com/jobs/search?q=<kw> (redirects to /jobs/search/<id>), job pages at /jobs/<slug>-<id> as plain HTML (absolute URLs under /jobs/, so the paradox adapter's /job/ link pattern does not match). No JSON-LD and no JSON/RSS endpoint found; filtering uses a tsstoken form post.

Board is Webster's own and the API answers 200, but it is empty: total 0 postings with an empty search. Webster is now 'a division of Santander Bank, N.A.' (footer of https://careers.websteronline.com, which has no job search left and links out to https://www.santandercareers.com/). So there is nothing to scrape under the Webster name; openings have moved to Santander's careers site, which is a different employer and not recorded here. The paradox candidate from the auto pass (careers.websteronline.com) is only the marketing shell (/jobs redirects to the home page).

huntington-careers.com renders its search with JavaScript (no job links in static HTML). The Workday board behind it was found via web search (tenant huntington, wd12, site HNBcareers) and confirmed with the adapter: verify_one ok n=10, postings are Huntington locations (e.g. Beachwood, 3900 Park). The link from huntington-careers.com to this board was not observed directly in static HTML.
